title: PolyHedge
tagline: Package-based arbitrage platform: Pre-constructed hedging packages on Polymarket + DEX perpetuals
description: PolyHedge is an automated arbitrage platform that exploits pricing inefficiencies in Polymarket prediction markets while hedging directional risk through DEX perpetuals. Our mission is to democratize sophisticated trading strategies that were previously only available to institutional traders.
how_its_made: PolyHedge combines a Python market scanner (Black-Scholes pricing), Solidity smart contracts (package management), Node.js bridge (LayerZero cross-chain execution), and Next.js frontend (RainbowKit wallet). Users buy pre-constructed hedging packages that automatically execute arbitrage between Polymarket and DEX perpetuals, democratizing sophisticated DeFi strategies through event-driven automation.
